summary.text: Rachel Henderson is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 78 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia, which lists her as Rachel Ann Henderson, gives her profession as sales management.

paragraphs.text: Rachel Ann Henderson lives in Rumford, Maine, and her career experience includes working in sales management.
She assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 6, 2022, succeeding Cathy Nadeau.
In 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Judiciary Committee.
